page.title: Everything it takes to get your house out of the ground
page.lead: Planning, engineering and construction under one roof, so the people who plan your house are the same people who build it.

steps.title: How a project runs, from first call to handover

items.title: First conversation
items.body: Tell us about your plot, sketch or question. First conversations and site visits are free.

items.title: Cost plan
items.body: After an initial meeting and a look at the site, we prepare a cost plan for your house.

items.title: Design & price
items.body: We work with your architect to develop the design until it is reliable enough for a fixed or target price.

items.title: Construction
items.body: One project lead runs the site, with weekly progress, cost and risk reports.

items.title: Handover & aftercare
items.body: Twelve months of aftercare and a phone number that is always answered.

models.title: Three engagement models, one standard of work

items.name: Design & build
items.body: One contract and one team, from concept with your architect to handover. The simplest route to cost certainty.

items.name: Build only
items.body: Your design team completes the drawings; we price, plan and build them, with early buildability input if you want it.

items.name: Management
items.body: We manage programme, cost and quality on your behalf, procuring trade packages directly in your name.

items.a: Mainly in Tbilisi, Batumi and the Kakheti region, with selected projects elsewhere in Georgia.

items.q: What size of project do you take on?
items.a: From single private houses of around 300 m² to apartment and commercial buildings above 30,000 m².

items.q: Can you work with our own architect?
items.a: Yes. Most of our projects are designed by independent architects; our role is to make their design buildable and deliver it.

items.q: How do you price a project?
items.a: After an initial meeting we prepare a cost plan, then a fixed or target price once the design is developed enough to be reliable.
